biotools.summary:
ReviewAid is an open-source AI-assisted tool for full-text screening and data extraction in systematic reviews. It supports evidence synthesis workflows by using large language models to classify articles according to user-defined PICO criteria and extract structured information from full-text publications.

ReviewAid is designed as a supplementary reviewer rather than a replacement for human judgement. It aims to reduce manual workload, improve consistency, and assist researchers during screening and data extraction while maintaining human oversight throughout the evidence synthesis process.
